cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You lost the chess game. The agreement says you wash up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You were very serious about my washing up while you were winning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the dishes. Call it a practical interval.
